description: Extension eval for the team's three added local source-curation tools.

cases.query: Rank these already collected research items by their existing score and return the top 2: [{"title":"A","url":"https://example.com/a","score":0.4},{"title":"B","url":"https://example.com/b","score":0.9},{"title":"C","url":"https://example.com/c","score":0.7}]

metadata.what_it_tests: Routes ranking of existing scored items to rank_sources and preserves the requested top-2 limit.

cases.query: From these collected items, keep only sources from openai.com with score at least 0.7: [{"title":"A","url":"https://openai.com/a","score":0.8},{"title":"B","url":"https://example.com/b","score":0.9}]

metadata.what_it_tests: Routes domain and minimum-score filtering of supplied items to filter_sources.

cases.query: Group these already collected research items by publisher domain: [{"title":"A","url":"https://openai.com/a"},{"title":"B","url":"https://example.com/b"}]

metadata.what_it_tests: Routes publisher-domain grouping of supplied research items to group_sources.
